name: standup-recap
description: Turns what your coding agent did into an animated, step-by-step standup recap with real diffs, terminal output and an optional local voice.

interface.longDescription: Turns the work your agent did today into a short animated story: plan, explore, edit, run, test, ship. Real diffs and terminal output, one self-contained HTML file, optional narration from a free local voice, and MP4 export. It reads the session history Claude Code and Codex already keep, so nothing extra runs while you work.
defaultPrompt: Make a standup recap of today's work.
Export today's recap as an MP4.
